meaning:
This producer tag belongs to jetsonmade

Tahj Morgan, also known as jetsonmade (formerly stylised as JetsonMade), is a Carolina-based producer best recognised for producing many of DaBaby’s breakout songs, including “Suge,” “BOP,” “Goin Baby,” and “VIBEZ,” among others.

He has worked with 21 Savage, Roddy Ricch, Playboi Carti, YoungBoy Never Broke Again, Lil Keed, Young Nudy, Smokepurpp, and many other musicians, and has become a go-to producer in the Hip-Hop genre.

@jetsonmade

meaning:
This is the producer tag of ‘1st Class’.

1st Class, whose real name is Khaleel Griffin, is an accomplished hip-hop producer renowned for his work in the industry. He has amassed an impressive list of production credits, collaborating with notable artists such as Chance the Rapper, Gucci Mane, DaBaby, Moneybagg Yo, French Montana, G-Eazy, Dro Kenji, and numerous others. 1st Class frequently works alongside fellow producer jetsonmade and is a member of jetsonmade’s collective known as boymeetspace.
